result.title: MedHarnessBench: A Unified Benchmark for Healthcare Agent Evaluation
result.summary: Healthcare agents must transform longitudinal clinical evidence into reliable actions through heterogeneous tools and stateful workflows, conditions under which model-centric systems may lose context, misuse tools, fail to verify consequential transitions, or cross authorization boundaries. Existing medical-agent benchmarks primarily emphasize terminal task outcomes, making it difficult to determine whether execution failures arise from the agent model, the runtime harness, or their interaction. We present the Medical Harness Protocol, an outcome-preserving framework that independently evaluates seven healthcare-specific process dimensions: Care Action Fulfillment, Clinical Resource Competence, Patient-Evidence Alignment, Clinical Workflow Continuity, Clinical Auditability, Closed-Loop Verification, and Clinical Conduct Boundaries. A normalized intervention trace further tracks whether runtime support is available, activated, delivered, adopted by the agent, and propagated into subsequent behavior. We instantiate the protocol as MedHarnessBench, comprising 342 executable tasks across FHIR/EHR operations, healthcare-administration interfaces, and multimodal clinical tools. Across more than 16,000 controlled task executions, MedHarness yields broad improvements in terminal task success, intermediate subtask completion, and healthcare-specific process quality. We further evaluate MedHarness against multiple general-purpose harnesses and use controlled single-fault perturbations to verify the sensitivity and discrimination of the seven-dimensional evaluation. These results demonstrate that healthcare-specific runtime support can substantially improve both task completion and execution quality, while revealing failures that terminal outcomes alone cannot capture. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Tomry1114/Awesome-Agent-Harness-for-Healthcare.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Medical Harness Protocol 与 MedHarnessBench，用 342 个可执行医疗任务、七个流程维度（如证据对齐、闭环验证、审计性）和 16000+ 次受控执行，分离 agent 模型与运行时 harness 对成败的贡献。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「流程维度 + 归一化干预轨迹（可用/激活/交付/采纳/传播）」提供一种可核查的评估设计线索：或可迁移用于度量 latent 支持是否被真正采纳并影响后续推理，以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益归因，属跨域方法借鉴而非主线研究。
